decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording construction of both the Unit 1 living-room wall and the corridor partition wall.
Constructing the Unit 1 living-room and corridor partition walls does not necessarily alter the open-plan kitchen cabinetry, enclosure, or placement requirements.
